episodes.title: The Canopy That Never Sleeps
episodes.logline: Ayaan's everyday life in a thriving forest city is interrupted by a security drill that reveals a hidden threat.

scenes.title: Morning Above the Green
scenes.beat: Introduce the modern vanar city, Ayaan, and the community's interconnected life.

scenes.title: A Friendly Race
scenes.beat: Ayaan and friends compete, showing their skills and relationships through action.

scenes.title: The Leader's Briefing
scenes.beat: Veer responds to unexplained signal failures near an old forest boundary.

scenes.title: A Signal in the Roots
scenes.beat: Ayaan discovers evidence that someone is mapping the city's defenses.

scenes.title: Eyes in the Dark
scenes.beat: A watcher reports Ayaan's discovery to Kairav, establishing the long-term threat.

episodes.title: A Map with Missing Pieces
episodes.logline: Ayaan and Chiku investigate a corrupted map while Veer tries to keep rumors from destabilizing the city.

scenes.title: The Broken Archive
scenes.beat: Chiku recovers fragments of the relay's route map.

scenes.title: A Father's Warning
scenes.beat: Veer tells Ayaan that evidence without context can put innocent people at risk.

scenes.title: Unmarked Routes
scenes.beat: Mira identifies a route that bypasses official sensors.

scenes.title: A Quiet Interception
scenes.beat: The friends evade a masked patrol and lose part of the map.

scenes.title: Kairav Makes an Offer
scenes.beat: Kairav publicly offers help while privately ordering surveillance.

episodes.title: The Brother in the Glass Tower
episodes.logline: A public celebration brings Veer and Kairav together, forcing Ayaan to question the story he has been told about his family.

scenes.title: Festival of Lights
scenes.beat: Show the community's traditions and modern civic culture.

scenes.title: Two Brothers, One City
scenes.beat: Veer and Kairav disagree over security and freedom.

scenes.title: Ayaan Overhears
scenes.beat: Ayaan catches a fragment of a conversation about an old failed coup.

scenes.title: The Power Flicker
scenes.beat: A coordinated outage triggers a rescue sequence.

scenes.title: A Promise Unspoken
scenes.beat: Veer decides to investigate Kairav without exposing Ayaan.

episodes.title: The Test Run
episodes.logline: Ayaan's attempt to prove himself becomes a dangerous chase through the city's maintenance network.

scenes.title: Prototype Day
scenes.beat: A gadget demonstration goes sideways and reveals a useful signal pattern.

scenes.title: Unauthorized Pursuit
scenes.beat: Ayaan follows a suspicious courier against instructions.

scenes.title: Dead End
scenes.beat: The courier escapes after forcing Ayaan to choose between pursuit and helping a trapped worker.

scenes.title: The Choice
scenes.beat: Ayaan saves the worker, earning respect but losing the evidence.

scenes.title: A Report to Kairav
scenes.beat: Kairav learns Ayaan has begun investigating.

episodes.title: The Night the Lights Fell
episodes.logline: A staged emergency fractures public trust and gives Kairav the opening he has been waiting for.

scenes.title: Power Grid Warning
scenes.beat: Multiple systems fail in a sequence too precise to be accidental.

scenes.title: Evacuation Lines
scenes.beat: Ayaan and friends help civilians escape while authorities struggle to coordinate.

scenes.title: The Emergency Vote
scenes.beat: Kairav uses fear to demand extraordinary control.

scenes.title: Veer's Last Stand
scenes.beat: Veer confronts Kairav and is outmaneuvered by a prepared force.

scenes.title: Rudra's Escape Route
scenes.beat: Rudra takes the young Ayaan away as the city falls under Kairav's control.

episodes.title: Beyond the Green Line
episodes.logline: Far from NeoVan, Ayaan struggles with loss while Rudra teaches him survival, restraint, and patience.

scenes.title: A Different Forest
scenes.beat: Ayaan experiences a quiet life without the technology he took for granted.

scenes.title: The Anger Drill
scenes.beat: Rudra interrupts reckless training and explains why anger is not a plan.

scenes.title: A Message Never Sent
scenes.beat: Ayaan tries to contact his friends but discovers the network is monitored.

scenes.title: The Long Walk
scenes.beat: A survival challenge forces Ayaan to trust Rudra's experience.

scenes.title: A Name in the News
scenes.beat: Ayaan sees a broadcast portraying Kairav as the city's savior.

episodes.title: Skills Are Not Strength
episodes.logline: Ayaan learns that skill without judgment can put the people he wants to protect in danger.

scenes.title: Three Disciplines
scenes.beat: Rudra introduces observation, movement, and de-escalation as equal disciplines.

scenes.title: The Bridge Challenge
scenes.beat: Ayaan must cross without abandoning a slower trainee.

scenes.title: A Fight Avoided
scenes.beat: Ayaan resolves a confrontation through listening rather than force.

scenes.title: Rudra's Old Debt
scenes.beat: Rudra reveals his connection to Veer and the failed evacuation.

scenes.title: The Return Decision
scenes.beat: Ayaan chooses to return, knowing the city may not welcome him.

episodes.title: A City That Forgot
episodes.logline: Ayaan returns to a polished but frightened NeoVan and discovers that his friends have learned to survive under surveillance.

scenes.title: The Checkpoint
scenes.beat: Ayaan sees new biometric controls and restricted movement.

scenes.title: Posters of a Hero
scenes.beat: Kairav's propaganda reframes the coup as a rescue.

scenes.title: A Familiar Signal
scenes.beat: Ayaan recognizes a pattern Chiku used in childhood.

scenes.title: The Reunion Trap
scenes.beat: Ayaan finds Chiku but an alarm forces them to split up.

scenes.title: Old Friends, New Rules
scenes.beat: Mira, Kabir, Zed, and Tara reunite with Ayaan cautiously.

episodes.title: The First Plan Fails
episodes.logline: The friends attempt to expose Kairav's control network but underestimate how thoroughly he has mapped their habits.

scenes.title: A Plan on Paper
scenes.beat: The group builds a nonlethal plan to copy the command logs.

scenes.title: Inside the Grid
scenes.beat: Mira and Chiku reach the archive while others manage the distraction.

scenes.title: A Familiar Weakness
scenes.beat: Kairav anticipates Ayaan's route and closes the exits.

scenes.title: Captured
scenes.beat: The friends are taken after choosing to protect a civilian informant.

scenes.title: Left in the Rain
scenes.beat: Wounded and abandoned, the group hears a calm voice approach.

episodes.title: The Wayfarer
episodes.logline: A humble stranger helps the wounded friends recover and begins teaching them that courage is service before victory.

scenes.title: A Small Fire
scenes.beat: The Wayfarer treats injuries with practical care and asks no reward.

scenes.title: No Easy Miracle
scenes.beat: The friends must rest and help one another; recovery is not instantaneous.

scenes.title: The First Lesson
scenes.beat: The Wayfarer asks what they were trying to protect, not whom they wanted to punish.

scenes.title: Strength with Limits
scenes.beat: Each friend discovers a discipline suited to their own strengths and limitations.

scenes.title: A Dawn Choice
scenes.beat: The group commits to freeing the city without becoming like its oppressor.
